lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in a structured grid posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, forming distinct grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient, with specular highlighting on the dorsal edge and shadowing on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch or irregular indentation is visible on the distal trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
